blurb: Ocean Fun Rentals offers pontoon boat and jet ski rentals in Madeira Beach, Florida, including captain-led or self-guided pontoon excursions and a guided Dolphin Jet Ski Tour. Guests can explore local waterways, sandbars, and islands, and may see dolphins, rays, and sea turtles. Reservations are recommended and deposits are required.
